sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-08-v16-full/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 47; Internal Quality Checks row 47)
.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-08-v16-full/rules/projects/webdev-task-template (task.toml, tests/Dockerfile, tests/test.sh, tests/tools/*, tests/scoring.toml, all judge.toml headers)
evidence: Judge agent and model are pinned once and shared: task.toml [verifier.env] sets REWARDKIT_JUDGE="claude-code" and REWARDKIT_MODEL="z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx" via OpenRouter, exactly the frozen block in staged-task-contract.md; all five judge.toml files carry only judge="claude-code" with no model/temperature/effort override, and test.sh:63-66 zeroes the run if either env var is missing. Judge CLIs and browser are version-pinned in tests/Dockerfile:16-22,31-35 (@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7; Chromium installed by the playwright bundled inside the pinned @playwright/mcp and symlinked to /usr/local/bin/chromium, which every judge.toml passes as --executable-path). Shared tools are byte-identical to the frozen template: diff shows tests/Dockerfile, test.sh, tools/score.py, tools/restart_mcp.py, scoring.toml and .dockerignore SAME, and every judge.toml header up to [scoring] (timeouts 600/600/9000/900/900, MCP args) matches the template; task.toml differs only in identity/metadata fields. Fixed-clock half: no graded rule depends on the calendar date - a grep of instruction.md, environment/instructions/*.md, app_context.md, prompts and criteria finds no today/date/ago/timezone rule; the only time rules are durations (five-second run budget and ~five-second cross-tab refresh in behaviour.md:5,11), and functional judge.toml:344 explicitly says how times or dates are displayed does not matter, so no run-date drift can flip a verdict. Counterexamples tried: a broken app cannot exploit judge drift because model/CLI/browser are fixed per image; a conforming app built on a different day cannot fail due to date rules because none exist. Notes (not defects per the client sheet and delivery profile): base images node:22-bookworm-slim/python:3.12-slim and apt fonts are tag- not digest-pinned and npm -g transitive deps float, but these lines are template-controlled and identical to the template; the Internal sheet's older 'temperature 0, versioned prompt, no unpinned network' wording is superseded by the client row text which says these are not required and public network is not a defect. This is a static-configuration verdict; raw-evidence-index.json states no configured-judge run exists on these v16 bytes, so actual image build/runtime of these pinned versions on v16 is not measured here (v15 hosted runs used the same template-identical tests/Dockerfile).
